messages:
liz-cs: Quick preflight update for SolaraHealth private deploy — overall green but a few blockers that could escalate to renewal risk if not resolved in 10 business days. KMS key currently flagged as non-rotatable, audit logs not set with lifecycle/replication to SIEM, and they hit a NAT egress quota during image pulls. I booked a 3pm PT quick sync. @samir-ops @maria-cs @jg-engr

samir-ops: thanks — can you paste the CMK ARN and current key policy? i can triage rotation options before the call

liz-cs: arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:111122223333:key/3a4b5c6d-EXAMPLE

maria-cs: heads-up: customer is concerned about audit retention (HIPAA). they want 7 years, want to confirm we support replication to their SIEM + S3 with vault-backed keys.

jg-engr: from infra side we need two things: 1) outbound https to container registry (443) allowed from the private subnets, and 2) NAT gateway egress quotas raised or replace with managed egress. the image pull failures were the NAT bursting limit.

samir-ops: looked at the KMS policy — it's a cross-account key but missing key rotation schedule. quick option: enable automatic rotation (if CMK is AWS-managed) or add a Lambda rotation for customer-managed keys. sample policy snippet I suggested in the call:

```json
{"Version":"2012-10-17","Statement":[{"Sid":"EnableRotation","Effect":"Allow","Principal":{"AWS":"arn:aws:iam::111122223333:role/cs-rotation"},"Action":["kms:EnableKeyRotation","kms:DisableKeyRotation"],"Resource":"*"}]}
```

maria-cs: i'll confirm whether they want AWS-managed rotation or bring-your-own rotation automation. if they want BYO, we should include runbook + 30-day ops handover.

jg-engr: audit logs: suggest S3 lifecycle rule + replication to their SIEM S3 bucket. also enable CloudTrail log file integrity validation. small policy snippet for bucket lifecycle: `Expiration: 2555` (7 years).

liz-cs: customer asked for a compliance package doc for auditors — can someone own assembling the artifacts (KMS policy, CloudTrail exports, SIEM replication proof, network diagrams)? this is high priority for renewal health.

samir-ops: ACTION: samir-ops -> implement CMK rotation plan and confirm rotation proof by EOD tomorrow. i will push a PR for the Lambda rotation if needed.

maria-cs: ACTION: maria-cs -> collect compliance artifact list and draft the auditor summary. aiming for initial draft by Friday.

jg-engr: ACTION: jg-engr -> request NAT quota increase and add ephemeral bastion for image pulls. pinged infra team ticket #INF-4321.

deploy-bot: [notice] infra: NAT quota increase request submitted (ticket INF-4321). ETA: 48h.

liz-cs: thanks. small mitigation while NAT quota pending: instruct customer to pre-pull images into a private ECR in their VPC. jg, can you share the minimal IAM role for that?

jg-engr: yes — use a role with `ecr:GetAuthorizationToken`, `ecr:BatchCheckLayerAvailability`, `ecr:GetDownloadUrlForLayer`, `s3:PutObject` for pre-pull export. i can paste a minimal inline role in the PR.

maria-cs: about renewal risk — i gave it a provisional "amber" health score because compliance artifacts are required for their legal review. if we close the artifacts and KMS rotation in 10 business days, we keep the deal. otherwise escalate to AM.

liz-cs: agree. i'll put a 2-week milestone in Gainsight and schedule a customer enablement session for rotation + audit walkthrough next Wednesday.

samir-ops: quick follow-up: we should validate CloudTrail S3 encryption uses the same CMK or a dedicated encryption key? customer prefers separation. i recommend a separate log-write key with strict IAM.

jg-engr: separate key is fine. we'll add key policy to restrict CloudTrail writes from `arn:aws:cloudtrail:*` only.

liz-cs: meeting notes + action items => i'll post a short summary doc after the call. please add PR links and tickets as you create them. thanks everyone. :thumbsup:

samir-ops: noted, will update thread when rotation is live.

maria-cs: will upload draft auditor summary here and ping legal for review.

deploy-bot: [notice] user-upload: https://redwood.internal/files/solara-health/preflight-summary-1867000000.pdf

liz-cs: closing loop for now — next sync if anything blocks. if anyone hits a blocker tag #cs-ops-urgent and i'll escalate.

samir-ops: done — rotation enabled, will share KMS rotation ARN and CloudTrail validation logs in thread (1867001200).

liz-cs: received. updated Gainsight health to "amber -> green" pending final SIEM replication proof. will follow up once Maria uploads the auditor doc.

maria-cs: uploaded draft and notes: https://redwood.internal/docs/cs/solarahealth/compliance-draft. please review by EOD tomorrow.

liz-cs: thanks all — great cross-team ops. :partyparrot:
